page.records.title: Records
records.empty.title: No records yet
records.empty.body: Log a working set with a weight on it and your records start here.
records.scopeNote: Records are kept per exercise and equipment. A dumbbell press never replaces a barbell press, because the two are not the same lift.
records.estimateNote: An estimated one-rep max is calculated from a set you actually did, not measured. Each one names the formula behind it.
records.bodyweightNote: Weighted bodyweight work is scored on the weight you added, so a record cannot arrive just because your body weight went up.

page.data.title: Data & backup
data.export.title: Export a backup
data.export.body: A readable JSON file you can keep anywhere. Everything in the app, in one file.
data.export.photosNote: Photos are stored as text in the file, which makes it about a third larger.
data.import.title: Restore from a backup
data.import.mergeNote: Keeps everything you have now and adds what the file has. Nothing is deleted.
data.import.replaceNote: Deletes everything on this device first, then restores the file exactly.
data.import.replaceBody: Every workout, measurement and photo on this device will be deleted and replaced with the contents of this file. A backup of your current data is exported first, automatically.
import.problem.unparseable: This file is not valid JSON, so nothing could be read from it.
import.problem.notABackup: This is not a REPLOG backup file.
import.problem.futureVersion: This backup was made by a newer version of REPLOG (format {found}, this app reads {supported}).
import.problem.missingData: This backup has no data in it.
import.problem.notAList: {store} is not a list of records and was skipped.

import.problem.malformed.one: One record in {store} is missing an id and will be skipped.
import.problem.malformed.other: {count} records in {store} are missing an id and will be skipped.

import.problem.duplicates.one: One record in {store} appears twice; the newer copy will be used.
import.problem.duplicates.other: {count} records in {store} appear twice; the newer copy will be used.

import.problem.orphans.one: One record in {store} points at something not in this file; it will be skipped.
import.problem.orphans.other: {count} records in {store} point at something not in this file; they will be skipped.

import.problem.unknownStores.one: This file has one section this version does not know about. It will be ignored.
import.problem.unknownStores.other: This file has {count} sections this version does not know about. They will be ignored.

import.problem.hashMismatch: This file does not match its own checksum, so it may have been edited or truncated. You can still import it.
import.problem.stopped: Stopped after {done} of {total} sections. Nothing further was written.

data.storage.title: Storage
data.storage.unknown: This browser will not say how much is used.
data.storage.persisted: Protected: this browser has agreed not to clear your data.
data.storage.besteffort: Best effort: this browser may clear your data if the device runs low on space. Export regularly.
data.storage.near: Storage is nearly full. Removing a few photos is the quickest fix.
data.storage.full: Storage is full. New photos cannot be saved; workouts still log normally.
data.reset.title: Reset all data
data.reset.body: Deletes every workout, plan, measurement and photo on this device. This cannot be undone.
data.reset.confirmBody: This deletes every workout, plan, routine, measurement, photo and personal record on this device. It cannot be undone, and there is no copy anywhere else.
data.about.title: Where your data lives
data.about.body: Everything is stored in this browser on this device. Clearing the site’s data, or offloading the app, removes it. A backup file is the only copy that survives that.
settings.units.title: Units
settings.workout.title: Workout
settings.profile.title: Profile
settings.library.title: Exercise library
settings.units.note: Everything is stored in metric and converted only for display, so changing a unit re-labels your history without altering a single recorded value.
settings.workout.restHint: Used when an exercise has no rest of its own. Per-exercise rest always wins.
settings.workout.restSound: Play a sound when rest ends
settings.workout.keepAwake: Keep the screen awake while training
settings.workout.haptics: Vibrate when a set is completed
settings.workout.trackingModeHint: Advanced adds RPE, RIR and set types to every row. Simple logs weight and reps only.
settings.workout.e1rmHint: Changes estimates only. Every weight and rep you logged stays exactly as logged.
settings.workout.suggestionsHint: Suggestions are marked as estimates and are never filled in for you.
profile.allOptional: Every field is optional, and nothing here is needed to log a workout. None of it is sent anywhere.
profile.name: Name
profile.namePlaceholder: What the app should call you
profile.sexHint: Used only where a formula asks for it. Nothing is inferred from it.
page.about.title: About
about.platform.title: What this app does, and does not do
about.platform.sync: Version 1 keeps everything on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
about.platform.offline: REPLOG works fully offline after its first load.
about.platform.storage: Your data is stored by the browser on this device. iOS may remove it if storage runs low, or if you clear website data. Export a backup regularly.
about.platform.restTimer: Timers keep perfect time while REPLOG is open. iOS cannot alert you once the app is in the background or the screen is locked.
about.platform.notifications: There are no notifications, and no permission is ever requested.
about.platform.photos: Photos never leave your device. Location data is removed when a photo is added.
about.platform.health: There is no HealthKit, Apple Watch or health-data integration.
about.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
about.diagnostics.note: Kept in memory for this session only. Nothing is uploaded, and nothing is written to disk.
about.diagnostics.empty: Nothing has gone wrong this session.
about.diagnostics.copyFailed: This browser would not give access to the clipboard.
about.credits.title: Credits and licence
about.credits.body: Built with Angular. Exercise data is REPLOG’s own. No analytics, no trackers, no third-party requests at runtime.
data.csv.title: Export a spreadsheet
data.csv.body: One table as a CSV file, for a spreadsheet or another app. This is not a backup: it cannot be imported back, and it leaves out photos and anything nested.
deleted.title: Recently deleted

deleted.body.one: Anything you delete waits here for a day before it is gone for good. Restoring a session brings back the sets that went with it.
deleted.body.other: Anything you delete waits here for {count} days before it is gone for good. Restoring a session brings back the sets that went with it.

deleted.empty.title: Nothing deleted
deleted.empty.body: Deleted workouts, measurements, plans and routines show up here.

deleted.expired.one: One item is past the recovery window and can only be deleted for good.
deleted.expired.other: {count} items are past the recovery window and can only be deleted for good.

deleted.purgeBody.one: One item will be removed from this device for good. It cannot be restored afterwards.
deleted.purgeBody.other: {count} items will be removed from this device for good. They cannot be restored afterwards.

reminder.title: Back up your training
reminder.never: Nothing has been exported yet. Everything you have logged lives only in this browser, on this phone.

reminder.stale.one: You last exported a day ago and have trained since. A backup file is the only copy that survives a cleared browser.
reminder.stale.other: You last exported {count} days ago and have trained since. A backup file is the only copy that survives a cleared browser.

update.title: Update available
update.body: A new version has been downloaded and will be used the next time you reload. Your training history is not affected either way.
update.held: Held until your session is finished.
update.broken.title: Some app files are damaged
update.broken.body: Your training history is untouched: it is stored separately from the app and is not part of what needs repairing. The browser’s copy of REPLOG itself is incomplete, so it has to be downloaded again.
install.title: Add REPLOG to your home screen
install.ios: In Safari, tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen. REPLOG then opens full-screen, like an app.
firstRun.title: Where your training is kept
firstRun.body: Everything you log stays in this browser, on this device. Nothing is uploaded, and nobody else can see it — including us. The trade is that clearing your browser’s website data, or offloading the app, deletes it.
